rec.name: Swipeable Auto-Rotating Slider (Configurable Slide Interval)

what.text: A slider or carousel whose auto-advance interval (time between slides) can be set by the merchant in the theme editor. Customers can also swipe through the slides manually on touch devices. The ticket does not say what the slides contain, such as banners, USPs, announcements or products.

why.text: Swipe gestures are the expected way to browse on mobile, so customers can control the pace and see the content that interests them. A configurable interval lets the team test whether faster or slower rotation changes exposure and engagement. Auto-rotation plus manual control lets several messages share one slot without forcing the customer to wait.

how.text: Add a range setting to the section schema for the autoplay delay, for example 2 to 10 seconds in 1-second steps, with an optional autoplay on/off toggle. Use a touch-enabled slider library or CSS scroll-snap with a small JS autoplay timer, and read the delay from a data attribute set by Liquid. Pause autoplay on user interaction or hover, and show dots or arrows as navigation.

items: Slide interval in seconds (editor range slider, stated in ticket)

dependencies.text: No metafields or apps are mentioned. Assumes a theme-editor section with blocks for the slides and a touch-capable slider script. The page and slide content are not specified in the ticket.

items: Scroll depth / engagement past the slider
Conversion rate and revenue per session for the page
